QuestInfo.name: Ludibrium Winter Preparations
QuestInfo.0: Marcel, who is in charge of security for Ludibrium, seems to be worried about something. Go see Marcel.
QuestInfo.1: Marcel, the guard at Ludibrium, wants to create a new toy for the children's winter playtime.  He needs yellow felt pieces to make the toy. Get the felt from the toy monsters in Ludibrium.
QuestInfo.2: You gathered felt from the monsters in Ludibrium and delivered it to Marcel. He said it will be used to create a new toy. What kind of toy could he be making?

0.0: Welcome to Ludibrium. Are you enjoying your winter break? Here in Ludibrium, we are trying our best to produce new toys for the children of Maple World. However, we are facing a shortage of materials. Would you please help us?

yes.0: The material needed for the new toy is a yellow felt piece which can be acquired from the toy monsters in Ludibrium. Please get #e#b20 pieces of felt#k#n and bring them to me.\n\n#b#i4032566# #t4032566# x 20

no.0: That's too bad... Your help would've been great.
